_doc: Rows of fig_maze_conditions, top to bottom. One entry = one row. To add a row: append an entry with status 'landed', its BARS artefact and schema ('w16' = rows.nway[arm].per_seed; 'w19' = rows.nway.per_seed[arm]). No code change. Labels are the Head's rule (PREREG-w21-words-full-test.md, THE LABEL RULE), applied by one function to every symmetric row; an asymmetric row is labelled ASYMMETRIC and gets no claim label. Where the artefact carries HEAD_LABEL the build asserts equality. w22: schema 'runs' = one scored run JSON per seed (ROWS.nway[arm]); 'check_source' = an artefact whose rows.nway.R_star and CLU_per_seed must equal the recomputed ones. The six-seed, two-config words-plus-observation read is panel (b), drawn by maze_six.py from the per-seed run JSONs (no claim label: the rule is written for 3 seeds).
